mapper.select: SELECT c.comment_id, c.feed_id, c.user_id, c.reply_to_id, c.reply_to_user_id, c.content, c.status, c.create_time, u.nick_name AS user_nick_name, u.avatar AS user_avatar, r.nick_name AS reply_to_user_name FROM feed_comment c LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON c.user_id = u.user_id LEFT JOIN sys_user r ON c.reply_to_user_id = r.user_id WHERE c.feed_id = #{feedId} AND c.status = 'normal' AND c.tenant_id = #{tenantId} ORDER BY c.create_time ASC

SELECT c.comment_id, c.feed_id, c.user_id, c.reply_to_id, c.reply_to_user_id, c.content, c.status, c.create_time, u.nick_name AS user_nick_name, u.avatar AS user_avatar, r.nick_name AS reply_to_user_name FROM feed_comment c LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON c.user_id = u.user_id LEFT JOIN sys_user r ON c.reply_to_user_id = r.user_id WHERE c.comment_id = #{commentId} AND c.status = 'normal' AND c.tenant_id = #{tenantId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO feed_comment (feed_id, user_id, reply_to_id, reply_to_user_id, content, create_time , tenant_id) VALUES (#{feedId}, #{userId}, #{replyToId}, #{replyToUserId}, #{content}, NOW() , #{tenantId})
mapper.update: UPDATE feed_comment SET status = #{status}, update_time = NOW() WHERE comment_id = #{commentId} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId}
